_comment: Single source of truth for every data series ingested by the platform. Every Bank of Canada series_id below was verified against the live Valet API. StatCan tables are pulled as full official CSV extracts and filtered by descriptor text at runtime, so no vector IDs are hard-coded/guessed.

tables.notes: The 'Categories' descriptor column is resolved case-insensitively at runtime; if StatCan renames a member the ingester logs a schema-change warning and records the affected filter rather than silently dropping data. StatCan national balance sheet levels use UOM 'Dollars' with a millions scalar factor.
